---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a focused improvement
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## User problem

Who needs this, and what problem are they trying to solve?

## Proposed outcome

Describe the smallest useful behavior and how success would be measured.

## Scope and constraints

List important non-goals, compatibility requirements, security considerations, and dependencies.

## Alternatives considered

Describe other approaches and why they are not preferred.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The expected behavior is testable.
- [ ] Documentation and operational impact are understood.
- [ ] The change can be delivered incrementally.
